text:
The mouse eradication attempt on Gough Island first commenced in 2021, when the Gough Island Restoration Programme ran its baiting campaign; the earlier 2007–2008 feasibility study was a survey, not an eradication operation. My earlier claim that the campaign was declared successful was unsupported: a later RSPB update says it has not met its primary goal of eradicating every mouse, so the outcome is unresolved. The team note's "early 2010s" start doesn't match the sources, which put the feasibility study in 2007–2008.
CONFIDENCE: 70
